certificates.sourceEvidence: LinkedIn's 2020 course announcement identifies the exact title and Scott Duffy. LinkedIn's cloud-training page also lists the course, but its linked catalog URL currently returns 404, and no active lesson page from this exact course was found. The live announcement is provided as a course reference link. The overview is a title-based summary; no official detailed syllabus was retrievable.
